title: Junior Video Editor
description_text: Gregory - named PR Agency of the Year by PR Daily and to PRWeek's Best Places to Work list - is looking for a Junior Video Editor to join our Creative Department! Candidates must be within commuting distance of our Ardmore, PA office. We are one of America's most innovative communications agencies, redefining what's possible through the power of people and AI. Responsibilities: build creative videos for Gregory and clients, edit short-form and long-form video content, build motion graphics in After Effects, record/edit/publish podcasts, turn around client videos quickly.

title: Brand Content and Social Media Manager - Independent Contractor
description_text: Jala is a yoga-inspired brand for original souls. Female-founded, family-operated apparel brand creating timeless, comfortable pieces ethically made in Southern California and hand dyed in small batches at their Phoenix dye studio. Compensation $2,000-$3,000/month independent contractor. Looking for a creative, social-media-obsessed Brand Content & Social Media Manager to grow online community, expand brand presence, bring the Jala story to life through content.

title: Social Media Manager
description_text: KBUILD is seeking a creative, motivated Social Media Manager to join their growing team. Full-time, in-person role. Responsibilities include content planning, capturing/editing photos and short-form videos, scheduling across Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/YouTube/LinkedIn, community management, analytics. Applications go to kbuildmedia1@gmail.com (resume + portfolio).

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description_text: UK's fastest-growing builders merchants, supplying premium building materials to London and Essex construction markets since 2013. Looking to recruit a Social Media & Content Manager to take ownership of MGN's social media presence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube - content planning, production coordination, on-camera presenting, coordinating cameraman and video editor.
